## Featured AI/ML Projects
1. **ISLR Studio (Indian Sign Language Recognition)**: Real-time hand landmark sequence tracking & translation. 18ms inference budget on CPU.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/swapnil3104/Indian-Sign-Language-Recognition-Using-Machine-Learning
2. **DrishtiDrive AI**: Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) with 3D facial landmark estimation, PERCLOS drowsiness tracking (99.4% precision), and edge alert telemetry.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/swapnil3104/DrishtiDrive-Advanced-Driver-Monitoring-System
3. **RoadGuard AI**: Automated road infrastructure hazard & pothole detection system using custom trained YOLOv8 with GeoJSON telemetry tagging.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/swapnil3104/Road-Pothole-Detection-System
4. **Self-Care AI**: Conversational health assistant powered by fine-tuned BioBERT, providing multi-turn symptom screening and wellness recommendations.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/swapnil3104/Self-Care-Chatbot-Medical-Assistance-System
